Subject: EdgePay MAP kickoff — access, acceptance criteria, and target bench windows

Hi Samuel / Emily,

Thanks for a great demo last week. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lists the technical milestones we discussed and the benchmark acceptance criteria for production readiness. High level ask from our side to keep on schedule: provision a test workload that mirrors your peak hour (sample payloads), a test account with scoped API key(s), and network access to the staging env by Apr 18 so we can run the first load window.

Key MAP items (TL;DR):
- Provision staging API key & service account (scoped, revocable) — owner: EdgePay
- Provide sample workload (3 representative endpoints + token length distribution) — owner: EdgePay
- Redwood to run two load windows (soak + spike) and deliver P50/P95 latency, TTFT, sustained throughput, and concurrency breakdowns — owner: Redwood
- Success criteria: P95 latency < 350ms for 512-token median payload at target concurrency; TTFT < 100ms for cached prefixes; no dropped requests at 95% of target throughput

Proposed windows (subject to your ops calendar):
- Apr 19, 08:00–10:00 PT — baseline soak (steady 100r/s)
- Apr 23, 01:00–03:00 PT — spike test (bursts to 400r/s, 10min bursts)

I attached the MAP draft (MAP_Redwood-EdgePay_v1.3.pdf). Please confirm owners and whether Apr 18 access is possible. If you prefer a different window, share the calendar link and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Olga

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-04-22T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Bench run complete — summary, raw results & notes

Team — we executed the scheduled spike window on Apr 23 00:55–03:05 PT (warm-up + 3 bursts). Attach: edgepay-bench-results-20270423.csv and brief notes below.

Summary metrics (representative):
- Target concurrency profile: sustained 100 r/s baseline, peak bursts to 400 r/s (10min bursts)
- Sustained throughput observed: 102 r/s at baseline with 5% variance
- Peak throughput during bursts: sustained 390–410 r/s across GPU pool
- Latency (512-token median payload): P50 = 85 ms, P95 = 312 ms, P99 = 520 ms
- TTFT (token generation start): median = 78 ms; 95th = 145 ms (note: TTFT is higher on cold KV cache)
- Error rate: 0.7% total (primarily rate-limit retries from load generator bursts)
- Observations: prefix cache reduced TTFT by ~40% for repeated prefixes; quantized int8 path gave ~1.7x throughput vs fp16 on same hardware; tail p99 spikes mapped to transient GC on a single replica during one burst window.

Action items and recommended follow-ups:
1) We recommend expanding the GPU pool by +1 replica and enabling controlled request throttling to avoid p99 spikes during sustained bursty traffic.
2) For production SLA at your target concurrency, consider a small cache tier at the LB to accelerate common prefixes.
3) Redwood to provide an annotated CSV + visual graphs (shared link) and a short exec summary for procurement to include in the SOW.

Marissa: please assemble the executive summary and upload to the Drive. Vanessa: can you prepare the SLA language we discussed for the SOW (latency targets, allowable error rates, escalation)?

Karthik

Subject: Final MAP update & ask — acceptance signoff and SOW insert

Hi Samuel / Emily,

Thanks for the coordination — attached are the annotated results and a short exec summary. Quick recap against the MAP acceptance criteria:
- P95 latency: 312 ms (target < 350 ms) — PASS
- TTFT: median 78 ms with cached prefixes; target < 100 ms — PASS
- Sustained throughput: ~102 r/s baseline with stable coverage — PASS for baseline target
- Concurrency/peak: handled 390–410 r/s bursts with 0.7% error; we recommend the small pool expansion to meet a 99.9% no-drop SLA at peak

Request: if you are comfortable with the baseline acceptance, please confirm via reply and we will convert the MAP to final SOW language and issue the procurement-ready MAP + SOW bundle. Procurement, cc'd, asked for a 1–2 page acceptance appendix we can insert; we attached a draft appendix.

Next steps we propose:
- EdgePay signoff (email reply) on baseline acceptance — target Apr 28
- Redwood to deliver SOW appendix and final MAP (for PO) — within 48 hours of signoff
- Joint plan for phased rollout (canary) once PO is issued

Appended attachments: MAP_Redwood-EdgePay_v1.3.pdf (annotated), edgepay-bench-results-20270423.csv, acceptance-appendix-draft.pdf, load-window-schedule.ics

Thanks,
Olga
